main_text.p: imposterùm simile tentator: De subsidio ab agrariis petito ad solutionem aris alieni veteris, & impensas necessarias, quoniam non satis adhuc res liquet, iidem tenentur es illud alienum & impendia necessaria apud Ordines generales exponere, ut re cognita ab iis statui & ferri sententia possit. Omnia hæc salvo jure fœderum & pactorum inter provincias socias in Belgio, & sine diminutione auctoritatis Ordinum generalium & Gubernatoris, quæ ex transactione Groningana anni M. D. XCIV, aut alias his debetur. Postremò postulata reliqua partium reiiciuntur, & sumptus compensantur. Pronunciatum die XI Januar. anno M. D. XCVII. Subscripsit nomine Ordinum generalium C. AERSEN. Verum ex sententiæ hujus verbis cum nova lis esset orta partibus, ea ad Ordines generales iterum relata, ab iis cognitio & judicandi potestas prioribus judicibus delegata fuit. Hi à biennio, anno scilicet M. D. XCIX, die XXVII Febr. page.notes: Transcription is from a faint scan. "dicam" in the right margin note is uncertain and marked [?]. The margin note's line breaks are joined ("eo-rundem"). Italic and roman boundaries in the body are read from the scan and may be slightly off. The running head "Groninga" is read as printed. The last line of text is cut off at the catchword "agro", which is kept in bottom_margin only. The Roman numerals are copied as printed, with the broken spacing closed up.
